answer: Farming becomes a zenith bet on surviving 104 epochs of grading, and every island settlement recomputes the sable schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 104 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
